data.one_liner: Chart generator with interchangeable chart engines like ChartJS and ApexCharts.
data.what_it_does: Generates charts using interchangeable underlying chart engines like ChartJS and ApexCharts. Automatically bundles and loads the required JavaScript libraries. Handles chart configuration generation without needing explicit engine documentation.
use_when: You want to generate charts on the web using ChartJS or ApexCharts from Dart.
You want to be able to switch between different chart engines without rewriting chart data setup.
avoid_when: You are building a non-web Flutter app, as this package targets web / dart platforms.
You prefer a native Flutter widget chart implementation rather than JS-interop wrapper engines.
strengths: Supports interchangeable chart engines (ApexCharts and ChartJS).
Bundles required JavaScript libraries out of the box.
Fallback Date adapter for ChartJS time series without needing Moment.js.
weaknesses: Relies on external JS charting libraries via interop.
data.setup_notes: JavaScript libraries are bundled automatically by the package.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pure Flutter implementation for charts rather than relying on JS interop.
